name: definition-transition-month-start-day-matches-start-only
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0), rejected by the cross-block checks on exceptions.history, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. 15 January years change to 1 April years through a transition from 2024-01-15 to 2025-04-01. The transition's month_start_day 15 is the day of transition.start but not of from (1), which is enough for the error; its quarters are then not compared with its number of months. The complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, exceptions (fiscalclock 0.2.0, ADR-0032), and spec/api-v1.md, Paths for common errors
source.checked_by: Manual reading of the 0.2.0 text of https://github.com/Karthik-beta/fiscalclock/blob/main/spec/definition-v1.md#exceptions and https://github.com/Karthik-beta/fiscalclock/blob/main/spec/api-v1.md#error (Paths for common errors), 2026-11-15; conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py Calendar.change_errors gives the same codes, paths and order (asserted)
